cut_space: u^2 + v^2 - w^2 kept ; Exp(theta R) turns (u, v) by 2 theta ; Exp(eta K), Exp(eta S) boost (v, w), (u, w) by 2 eta
cycle: (iota kappa)^2 = Exp(-2 eta n) with sinh(eta) = w : cycles add rapidity 2 eta each

response.D>0: the response has a cut; its cycle is a boost
response.D<0: no cut: the traceless part is a turn; the cycle is a rotation

tower: tanh(eta) is the same at every level of the tower
